title.suggested: Allen Calls Report of Mace Match a Bogus Challenge

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, holding to his announced retirement, dismissed a New York telegram saying Jim Mace had accepted his challenge for a May fight, calling such bogus challenges a bid for notoriety.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Dispatch, Saturday Evening, November 21, 1874'.

facts.fact: Allen held to his announced retirement from the ring and denied a New York report that Jim Mace had accepted his challenge for a championship fight the next May
places: Allen's headquarters, Washington Avenue, St. Louis

facts.fact: Allen said those getting up bogus challenges after his retirement were working hard for notoriety
facts.quote: working mighty hard for a little notoriety
